title: Freya and the Cipher
author: V. M. Sandoval
blurb: Beatrix Crane, a hotel concierge who notices everything, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
